why_engine.note: WHY explanations combine observed environmental conditions and, when available, existing SHAP outputs. They indicate associations and model drivers; they are not causal proof.

source_fingerprint.note: Statistical/source indicators only. These are not definitive chemical source-apportionment results.

actions.action: Increase road-dust suppression and clean visibly dusty corridors.
actions.rationale: Particulate loading or dust indicators are elevated.

actions.action: Strengthen construction-site dust controls, covering, wheel-wash and material-handling checks.
actions.rationale: Resuspended or construction dust is a plausible contributor.

actions.action: Focus enforcement and traffic-management measures on congestion corridors and idling hotspots.
Prioritize industrial-emission inspections and compliance checks.

policy_to_action.note: Policy mapping connects observed conditions with control measures. It does not establish causal policy impacts.

preview.methodology: Heuristic scenario range using conservative intervention assumptions; not a causal effect estimate and not a validated policy counterfactual.

intervention_simulator.note: Scenario outputs are heuristic ranges, not causal estimates.

integration_policy: Additive only. The Innovation Layer consumes the existing environment report and does not replace RAG, ML, XGBoost, WeatherAPI, LangGraph, SHAP, DBSCAN, or source-analysis modules.
